card.reminder.name: Reminder

card.title.description: Heading: overline, section or room title, with entity values (e.g. temperature)
card.title.error.strings: badges: plain text entries – edit in YAML

card.weather.description: Sky, rain, fog and wind behind the view's cards plus weather effects on Lumen cards. One per view, takes no space
card.weather.name: Weather background
editor.help.arming_time: Length of the countdown bars when the alarm does not report it (arming_time / delay attributes)
editor.help.badge_entities: How many of the chosen entities are active (e.g. heating, on, open). Empty: how many thermostats in the panel are heating
editor.help.battery_entity: A % sensor or a battery binary sensor. Empty = Better Thermostat's battery info on the thermostat itself
editor.help.cards: A list of card configs, as in a vertical stack
editor.help.days: How many days of the calendar to show
editor.help.device_class: Changes the icons and colours, e.g. “Door” for an opening contact on a door. Empty = as in HA
editor.help.disarmed_color: Neutral by default; e.g. red as in the Dom panel
editor.help.edit_note: Shown only while editing the dashboard, e.g. "phone copy". Cards with a screen condition (their own or their section's) get a label in edit mode automatically
editor.help.fab: The card leaves the grid and becomes a round button in the bottom-right corner of the screen
editor.help.fab_narrow_only: On: floating button only on screens narrower than 1024 px (phone, portrait tablet), a regular card on wider ones. Off: always a floating button
editor.help.fab_sheet_cards: Cards inside the panel (YAML list); climate cards show as compact thermostat rows
editor.help.fab_side: Which screen edge the floating button sits at. Each side has its own stack of buttons
editor.help.fan_modes: Nothing selected = every fan speed of the device (more than 5 become a drop-down list)
editor.help.feedback: Without it the card only runs the action
editor.help.haptic_tick: Vibration type every 1 % while dragging. How strong each type feels is up to the HA app and the phone. Empty = lightest
editor.help.haptics: Gentle vibration on tap, hold and drag (HA app and Android browsers)
editor.help.hash: Going to this #hash opens the pop-up (e.g. a button with a navigate action to #name)
editor.help.height: In pixels; empty = default (52, compact 36). Under 48 px one line: name left, value right, chart behind
editor.help.hvac_modes: Nothing selected = every mode of the device (up to 4 in one row, more in a grid of 3)
editor.help.layout_screen: Auto: compact on screens narrower than 1024 px
editor.help.layout_width: Auto: compact when the card is narrow (e.g. 3 grid columns)
editor.help.max_width: The card is never wider than this and stays centred in its place. Percent is of its place in the grid. Empty = the full width
editor.help.volume_remote: Android TV Remote: the remote entity of this player, so a long jump is one fast command
editor.help.volume_step: Only for a player with volume keys and no level. How much one key changes
editor.help.narrow_only_fab: Below 1024 px a button in the corner, wider a row in the grid
editor.help.nav_items: Views of the dashboard: path (rooms or /lovelace/rooms), name and icon
editor.help.nav_position: Bottom: fixed over the screen edge, the card itself leaves a spacer (put it last); In the grid: a normal card
editor.help.pm: One of PM2.5, PM10 or AQI is enough
editor.help.power_action: Default: turns on the last mode or turns the device off
editor.help.power_entity: A relay or plug that cuts the bulb's power. While it is off the bulb shows “Off” instead of “Unavailable”, and a tap turns the relay on. Empty = the bulb is always powered
editor.help.power_entities: Several relays or plugs feeding this light, usually a group of bulbs. The card gets one button per relay and only they switch the relays: a tap on the card does nothing. While any relay is on, the card sets the brightness and colour of the whole light. Replaces the field above
editor.help.presence_badge: Shown next to the name while presence comes from the presence sensor (default BLE; empty hides it)
editor.help.presence_entity: E.g. a BLE sensor; without it the person's zone counts
editor.help.secondary_entity: Its state is the second line (e.g. the vacuum status)
editor.help.show_trigger: A row in the dashboard that opens the pop-up; off = the card is invisible
editor.help.stale_after: Empty or 0 = never. No new reading for this many hours = dashed card, "Outdated · 3 h". Many thermometers only report when the temperature changes
editor.help.step: How much − and + change the setpoint. Empty = the device's step
editor.help.styles: CSS added to the card, e.g. .press { border-radius: 8px }
editor.help.sub_buttons: Small buttons on the right of the card, each with its own entity and action. At most 4 are shown, 2 on a narrow card and 1 on a compact one; the rest is hidden
editor.help.warnings_entity: Sensor with a warnings list attribute, e.g. IMGW-PIB Monitor
editor.help.weather_effects: Works with a “Lumen · Weather background” card in the same view
editor.help.weather_hours: 4–8; the card shows as many columns as fit at 44 px or more
editor.name: Name
card.spacer.description: Empty space, by default as tall as the floating buttons on screen
card.spacer.name: Spacer
editor.help.spacer_height: In pixels. Empty = as tall as the floating buttons on screen, so the last card can always be scrolled above them; with no floating buttons the card takes no space
card.purifier.name: Air purifier
card.purifier.description: Purifier and humidifier in one tile
card.purifier.error.domain: The entity must be in the fan domain
card.purifier.msg.no_answer: The device did not confirm the change
card.purifier.editor.min_label: Text of the minimum, e.g. Off
card.purifier.help.layout: A wide card or a compact row
card.purifier.help.preset_modes: Which modes to show and in what order. Empty = all the device has
card.purifier.help.speeds: Empty = buttons follow the device's speed step and are numbered
card.purifier.help.humidity_targets: Target buttons. They work with a humidifier entity or the service below
card.purifier.help.target_service: For integrations without a humidifier entity, e.g. service: my_integration.set_target_humidity, field: humidity
card.purifier.help.when: E.g. attribute: function, contains: Humidification. Empty = always when there is a humidity reading
card.purifier.help.filters: Empty = sensors with “filter” in the name on this device. Attribute or entity, unit %, h or d
card.purifier.help.controls: An entity (switch, list, number) or your own service: attribute, service and value field
card.purifier.help.confirm_timeout: An unconfirmed change is undone after this time. Default 45 s
card.purifier.help.send_delay: How long the card waits after the last tap before it sends a command, so a burst of taps is one command. Default 0.8 s
card.purifier.help.index: A value beside PM2.5, e.g. an allergen index: name, attribute or entity, thresholds, labels, max
editor.sub_buttons_hidden: {n} sub-button(s) not shown: this card has room for {max}
editor.title: Title
error.cards: cards must be a list of cards
